facts.text: Cedric signed a promissory note to get the party three-quarters price, about 975 gold pieces, for the barrow treasure. He pays once the caravans flow again and his messenger can truck the goods to town.
facts.uncertain_reason: The beats never say how much of the note's value was promised to Malzazarik and Lady Hilda, or whether the party still holds the note.

facts.text: The party recruited the wizard Malzazarik and Lady Hilda on the strength of Cedric's promissory note, and owes them payment from it.
facts.uncertain_reason: Play never stated the amount or terms promised to the hirelings.
